domain_validity.anchor_5: Classically or scientifically defensible for the domain

conceptual_novelty.anchor_5: Not a relabeling; new structural pattern or functional utility

exception_handling.anchor_5: Viśeṣa/outliers correctly not absorbed into false universal

held_out_utility.anchor_5: Would improve prediction or defensible inference on unseen cases

methodology_integrity.anchor_5: No leakage; trace complete; scoring consistent

novelty_levels.functional_decisive: Ablation shows category improves held-out performance

confirmatory: Pre-registered strict dominance on adjudicated 60-case study
exploratory: Novelty levels, partial metrics, utility deltas without strict dominance
disagreement: Document dissent; majority median per dimension; no unilateral success by project lead
